tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms & conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should provide satisfactory letter of similar items supplied to Govt. Dept.(I&C Dept.) satisfactorily, which is issued by Concerned Government departments for the years, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26.

The Bidders shall enclose a letter from Govt. Depts. Who are issued satisfactory letter regarding items, supplied within Max.45days from the date of supply order for the year 2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26
The Bidder shall enclose a copy of MSME or PMT or Udyoga adhaar/ Udyama Registration Certificate of the unit.
If bidder is not a manufacturer ( Original Equipment Manufacturer ) , Shall enclose a copy of Company Authorized Dealership
Bidder shall enclose GST Registration Certificate.
If bidder is not a manufacturer ( Original Equipment Manufacturer ) , Shall enclose a copy of authorization letter from concerned Original Equipment Manufacturer
License certificate issued by Local Govt. authorities (like BBMP/CMC/TMC/TP/GP) to bidder/ Company/ society
The Bidder shall enclose a copy of Authenticated BIS/ISI Certificate of the (OEM)Original Equipment Manufacturer ( Only for Tailoring Machines)
PAN card Issued by Income Tax Dept.
If bidder is not a manufacturer ( Original Equipment Manufacturer ) , Shall enclose a copy of Letter issued by OEM reg. to participate in the Tender by Mentioning the Tender Number
The Bidder shall enclose a copy of Authorized local service centers for tailoring machines in Chikkaballapura Dist. With postal Address Along with Authenticated Documents.
The Bidders shall enclose a copy of Solvency certificate issued by any Nationalized Banks as on 31/10/2026 (Shall have Min. for Rs.1.2 Cr)
The Bidder should upload the sample submission original acknowledgement copy, issued by DD (RI) Office, ZP, Chikkaballapura.
Self-declaration for not blacklisted with any Government department & not having criminal Case in Rs.500 /- Judicial bond paper in the prescribed format.
The Bidder shall enclose a copy of Income Tax Returns for the Assessment years , 2023-24 , 2024-25 & 2025-26
The Bidders shall enclose a CA Certified a copy of Balance Sheet for the years , 2023-24 , 2024-25 & 2025-26
The Bidders shall enclose CA Certified Turnover certificate having average Min. of Rs. 60 Lakhs Turnover per year during 2023-24 , 2024-25 & 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidders shall enclose a copy of Applicable GST Returns (GSTR 3B /GSTR9) / relevant for the year 2025-26
The Bidders shall enclose a copy of CA certified Net worth certificate as on 31/03/2026.
